facts.text: Smalls, grab a cracker. Chocolate goes on first, then the marshmallow. I will show you the rest.
facts.why: Invented. Ham's real s'mores speech is 'First, you take the graham. You stick the chocolate on the graham. Then, you roast the mallow.' He never says 'cracker' or 'I will show you the rest'.
facts.fix: You stick the chocolate on the graham. Then, you roast the mallow.

fix_note.text: You stick the chocolate on the graham. Then, you roast the mallow.
